proposals.before: Tian Yi went out to meet his mother, younger brother, wife, and children and was captured by Liu Yan.
proposals.after: Tian Yi's mother, younger brother, wife, and children, whom he went out to receive, were captured by Liu Yan.
proposals.reason: Later units show Tian Yi still campaigning while his mother and brothers are held; 為延所獲 refers to the family, not Tian Yi himself.

proposals.before: Yi went out to welcome his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, and was captured by Yan.
proposals.after: Yi went out to welcome his mother, younger brother, wife, and children, who were captured by Yan.
proposals.reason: Parallel narrative (s0177) has the mother and brothers seized; Yi continues as actor, so the capture target is the kin group.

proposals.before: Someone said to him, 'Was not your husband the one who cursed you?'
proposals.after: Someone said to him, 'Was that not the one who cursed you?'
proposals.reason: 夫非罵爾者邪 refers to the elder wife he married, not a husband; the idiomatic English already has the correct referent.

decisions.reason: 邑迎母弟妻子，為延所獲 is followed by 後邑聞更始敗…遣使詣洛陽, so Tian Yi remains free and acting; the capture object is the kin group he went out to meet, not Yi himself.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 邑迎母弟妻子，為延所獲

decisions.reason: Same Chinese as r0001: 為延所獲 attaches to 母弟妻子; Yi continues as actor in the next sentence, so the literal must not make Yi the captive.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 邑迎母弟妻子，為延所獲

decisions.reason: In the anecdote, after 取其長者 someone asks 夫非罵爾者邪; 夫 is the classical demonstrative pointing to that elder wife who had cursed him, not 'husband'.
